title: We ported the original Doom to SQL
summary: A technical project that demonstrates the creative potential of SQL by implementing the classic Doom game entirely within a SQL database, using SQL queries to handle game logic, rendering, and game loop execution.
problem_solved: Pushes the boundaries of SQL beyond traditional database operations by using it as a general-purpose computation engine for real-time game rendering and logic.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative technical boundaries and provides educational insights into both SQL capabilities and game engine internals through a fun, unconventional implementation.
